LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling) • Paragraph
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling) • Paragraph in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we effectively articulate our ideas in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: The learner accurately identifies their nuclear family members as they write the short descriptions on introductions.

Values:
Social justice: The learner shares resources amicably when they use locally available materials to mould the given numbers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Link to other learning areas:
